text: Noor's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Thursday at 11 at the crematorium, wake at the Red Lion afterwards. Remind me to send her a card the day before.
chidi got made redundant fri, whole team gone. says hes fine but didnt sound it. meeting w HR monday 10am about the package
Helen is obsessed with Wolves at the moment, has a season ticket now and goes with her brother Rhys every home game. Wants the new away shirt for her birthday, which is sometime in March I think.
Hana and Wiremu have split up. She's moving back in with her mum next weekend. Need to check in on her the week after once she's settled.
Zhang plays go competitively, apparently ranked 3 dan. Tournament in Manchester the 12th at half 9, he's quite nervous about it. Text him good luck that morning.
Coffee with Dorota. She's been knitting a blanket for her niece for about six months, nearly done. Her niece Ioana is due in the spring.

Luca said his nan died last week. Funeral's sometime after Christmas because the family are all flying in from Italy. He's really struggling. They were close, she basically raised him while his parents worked. He's taking some time off work and might go over to Turin for a bit in the new year to help sort the house. Keep an eye on him, maybe take him for a pint at the weekend.
dentist tues 8.40, then pick up dry cleaning

so Amir was telling me about this board game cafe he goes to on Wednesdays, he's really into Twilight Imperium, games last like eight hours. He wants to get a group together sometime next month, I said I'm in. Apparently his flatmate Zhang paints all the miniatures and they've got a whole shelf of them. Bring snacks, it's a long one. He also mentioned he's been designing his own game on the side, wants people to playtest it after Christmas.
Joe's band are playing the Fleece on Saturday night, doors at 8. I'm going with Owen. Ask Joe how it went the next day, he's been rehearsing loads.
Alana and Lila's engagement party was meant to be on the 3rd but it's been called off, they've broken up. Lila's staying at her sister's for now.

Gareth - redundancy confirmed, last day end of Nov. Thinking of retraining as an electrician in the new year, course starts in January if he gets a place. Wife Nora is supportive but worried about money, they've just remortgaged. He was trying to be upbeat but you could tell he's gutted, he's been there 22 years. Ask him how the course application goes.
Nikhil reads loads of sci fi, just finished the whole Expanse series. Recommend him Children of Time.

Henrik's dog Bjorn has to have an operation on his hip Friday morning. Henrik's a wreck about it, Bjorn's eleven and the vet said there's some risk with the anaesthetic. He's dropping him off at 8 and they'll ring when he's out of theatre. Recovery is about six weeks of crate rest. Text him Friday afternoon to see how it went.
Layla is training for the Cardiff half in October. Running four times a week, knee is bothering her a bit. Her partner Victor is doing it too.
Ran into Krisztina at the shop. Her mum's funeral was last Tuesday. Must ring her soon, haven't spoken properly since.
Rhys - Liverpool fan, collects vinyl, mostly 70s soul. Hates jazz.

Voice memo. Okay so talked to Katarzyna for ages on the phone tonight. Her grandad, the one in Krakow, died on Monday, really suddenly. She's flying out Wednesday morning and the funeral is the day after she lands, so Thursday. She'll be back sometime the week after. Her boss has been decent about it. Remind me to message her Thursday evening, and maybe drop off some food when she's back.
Salma got into the county netball squad!! First session is Saturday at 10. Send congrats
Aidan's breakup with Ruby was a while ago now but he still seems low. Need to invite him out more. He's into climbing, maybe the bouldering place.

Ignacio - started learning cello in the summer, has his first little recital the 20th at 7pm at the music school. Scared stiff. His wife Saskia is filming it. He only picked it up because his late dad played, which is sweet. Teacher reckons he's doing really well for an adult beginner. Going to try and make it, if not message him the day before to say good luck and ask Saskia to send me the video afterwards.
Reza's grandma turns 90 next month, big family party the Saturday after. He wants to make her a photo book.
Pieter's leaving do is Friday at 5.30 at the Crown. Chip in for the card and present by Thursday.
Call w Noor. she's ok. back at work from monday. her brother Sam is staying with her for a bit
Chidi texted, got an interview at the council on the 28th at 2pm. First since the redundancy. Remind me to ask him how it went that evening.
Need to book the boiler service sometime before winter. And renew the car insurance by the 30th.
Helen's knitting group meets Tuesday nights at the library, she's making a cardigan with a cable pattern. She said wool from that shop in Hebden would go down well for Christmas.
Hana - new flat viewing tomorrow at 6, then another the day after. Mum's going with her to the first one. Fingers crossed for her.
wiremu doing ok after the split. playing loads of rugby, joined the vets team at the club. first match sat 2pm
Dorota's sister Krisztina had her baby! Little boy, born on Sunday morning. Dorota flies over to see them a week after.
Note from walk w Luca: he's got really into fly fishing, ties his own flies, goes up to the Wye most weekends. His birthday's 14 Feb, maybe a fly box.
Amir mentioned his mum's been in hospital since the weekend, scan on Wednesday afternoon. Check in with him Wednesday night.
Joe and his wife are doing up the spare room, their second baby is due in June. He's nervous about it all.
Owen's cat Pickles went missing on Monday, they've put posters up everywhere. Ask him tomorrow if she's turned up.
Lila said her dad's being made redundant after 30 years at the plant. Last day is before Christmas. She's worried about him.

long chat with Alana after book club. she's reading everything by Elena Ferrante, wants to do Italian lessons in the spring so she can read them in the original. thinks she might go to Naples in the summer. her girlfriend Hana isn't keen on the trip. no idea when book club is next, sometime soon
Gareth's darts league final is Thursday at 8, he's captain. Don't forget to text him good luck in the afternoon.
Nikhil and his partner have a gig at the jazz club the 9th at 9pm, he's on keys. I'm getting tickets for me and Nora.
Henrik's dad is retiring at the end of the year after 40 years teaching. Party in January sometime.
Layla's mum Mrs Johnson had a fall last week, broken wrist. Op on Monday morning. Layla is driving up the day before.
Victor got the job at the brewery, starts in the new year!
Krisztina mentioned she's thinking about going back to uni, maybe a part time MA in history, starting next autumn. Already looked at Birkbeck.
Ioana's grandad's funeral was yesterday. She did a reading. Remind me to send her a message tonight, and the week after ask if she wants to get lunch.
Gym, then food shop. Make soup for the week.
Rhys collects retro consoles, has like forty now. Wants a Dreamcast. Christmas idea.
Katarzyna's back from Poland. Says the funeral was lovely, lots of family she hadn't seen in years. Still tired. Maybe call at the weekend.
Salma and her husband Ignacio are off to Japan in the spring for their tenth anniversary. Two weeks, Tokyo then Kyoto. Their kids are staying with her parents.
Aidan Rossi from work - Spurs season ticket holder, does pub quizzes Tuesday, partner Gareth is a nurse. Lovely bloke.

Saskia was made redundant from the agency on the 1st. She's taking a few weeks off then looking for something new after Christmas. Her brother Pieter's helping with her CV. Must send her that job ad Monday morning.

Reza's choir concert at St Mary's is on the 15th at half 7. He's got a solo, he's terrified. I'm going with his sister Noor, we're meeting for food beforehand at 6. He's been rehearsing every night for weeks and his voice teacher thinks it's his best yet but he doesn't believe it. Ask him afterwards how he felt it went, and bring flowers.
